method: Deterministic rules-based rewrite from audit stats. Baseline untouched (human gate).

action.instructions: buy on strength only when the book can absorb it; be stricter after overnight audit

criteria.buy: the move is strong and depth is not thin; prefer deep quiet pumping with calm tape
criteria.sell: the move is fading or fees are climbing; prefer fading or dumping with harsh or loud tape
criteria.hold: anything else; prefer flat gray chop or unclear mixed signals

skip_this_cycle.instructions: conditions are too hostile to trade at all; prefer thin bot_war violent conditions
